fields.h1: Build a Landscaping Quote Form That Arrives Ready to Price
fields.hero_description: Build a landscaping quote form that asks for the service, the area size, and yard photos, saved to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What the Estimator Knows Before Calling Back
fields.features_subheading: A landscaping quote form built with Emergent gathers the job details an estimator would otherwise measure on site.
fields.feature_1:
Questions that change with the service

Pick mowing and the form asks for the lawn size and how often to cut. Pick a retaining wall and it asks for the length, the height, and what sits behind it, like a slope.
fields.feature_2:
Yard photos sent with the request

Customers add yard photos from a phone while they fill in the form. The photos stay attached to the request, so the estimator sees the slope and the old beds before calling.
fields.feature_3:
A price on screen for routine work

Set a rate for mowing, mulch, or leaf cleanup, and the form works out the price from the size entered. The customer sees it before submitting, and it is saved with the request.
fields.feature_4:
Large jobs sent to the estimator

Name the jobs that need a visit, such as any wall taller than 3 feet. Those requests show no price and email the estimator instead, photos included, to book the visit.
fields.feature_5:
Requests saved in a database you own

Each request becomes a row with the service, the address, the size, the price shown, and its status. Filter by status to see which quotes are still waiting on a reply.
fields.feature_6:
The code, in your GitHub repository

On paid plans, export the code for the form and its quote table to your GitHub repository. Host it on your own servers, or hand it to a developer to keep building on.
fields.why_title: Why Build Landscaping Quote Forms With Emergent?
fields.why_description: A request that says only "call me about my yard" means a drive out to measure. One that arrives with the square footage and photos can be priced from the truck.

faq_plan.q: What is a landscaping quote form?
How do I create a landscaping quote form?

plan.angle: The top results for landscaping quote requests are printable estimate templates and contractor contact pages that ask for a name and a message. This page shows the landscaping quote form a crew owner actually needs: the service, the property address, the area size, and yard photos, with recurring mowing priced on screen, tall retaining walls sent to an estimator, HOA common areas quoted on one request, and stale fall cleanup quotes put on a call list.
tab_stories: A lawn care company prices weekly mowing from the lawn size a homeowner enters, and a 7,200 square foot lawn shows $55 a visit and $1,540 for a 28-visit season before she submits.
A hardscape contractor takes wall length, height, and photos, and any retaining wall taller than 3 feet emails the estimator to book a site visit instead of showing a price.
A grounds maintenance company lets an HOA property manager list each common area as its own row, and three areas totaling 2.5 acres reach the account manager as one request.
A landscape company tracks 20 fall cleanup quotes sent in October, 14 accepted and 6 open, and every open quote older than 7 days goes on the owner's call list.
